support_lee: FYI CLARIPAY has been getting intermittent 502/504s from hosted inference since ~2026-03-14T11:30Z. They say some requests hang ~25-40s then 504. Attaching sample gateway lines and their customer trace IDs.

morgan: can you paste a sample trace id and any gateway/controller lines?

support_lee: sample id: trace_clp_20260314_01. Gateway excerpt:
```
2026-03-14T11:32:11Z gateway ERROR tenant=clari-pay trace=trace_clp_20260314_01 upstream_status=504 route=/v1/generate
2026-03-14T11:32:11Z controller INFO dequeue_wait_ms=3220 queue_depth=704 active_batchers=10 continuous_backlog=128
```

alex_engr: queue_depth 704 (limit 512) + continuous_backlog 128 = classic tail-saturation. Do we know payload sizes / seq lens and concurrency?

support_lee: CLARIPAY says normal user flow is ~1req/s with ~900-1400 token sequences. They also run a scheduled bulk reconciliation that fires every ~5m and spikes ~15-25 concurrent requests for ~2m.

jules_sre: repro plan: simulate their bulk job + long sequences against staging gateway to confirm backlog pattern. Quick load snippet (use staging token):
```
# spawn 18 concurrent long requests
for i in `seq 1 18`; do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-xl","input":"'$(python -c "print('A'*10000)")'"}' &
done
wait
```

morgan: ran the staging repro → queue_depth crept to ~700, continuous_backlog exceeded 120. Batcher logs show KV lock contention and slow kvcache loads: 
```
batcher ERROR tenant=clari-pay kvcache_miss=1 load_time_ms=2400 seq_len=1200
batcher WARN kv_lock_wait_ms=1950 waiting_for_kv_load
```

alex_engr: autoscaler telemetry? If batchers are full and autoscaler at cap, burst might be required.

deploy-bot: autoscaler snapshot: pool=hosted-eu-1 min_replicas=3 max_replicas=10 current_replicas=10 burst_allowed=false average_cpu=78%

alex_engr: autoscaler is at max_replicas and burst_allowed=false. Options to mitigate now:
- apply immediate tenant concurrency cap (rate-limit) on CLARIPAY (e.g., 10rps)
- enable burst on hosted-eu-1 to allow extra batchers
- temporarily route CLARIPAY traffic to a fallback lighter model (rwd-llama-large) for bulk job window
- reduce continuous_batch_window_ms and max_batch_size for pool temporarily
- enable kvcache async population or disable kvcache for tenant to avoid blocking KV load critical path

jules_sre: quick ops runbook (will run in this order):
1) set tenant soft-rate-limit 10rps
2) enable burst on pool hosted-eu-1 and allow burst_replicas up to 4
3) schedule a rolling restart of continuous-batcher pods to clear any stuck KV loaders
4) advise CLARIPAY to pause bulk job until p99 stabilizes

alex_engr: commands:
```
# soft rate limit
redwoodctl tenants rate-limit set clari-pay --rps 10 --type soft
# enable burst
redwoodctl pools update hosted-eu-1 --enable-burst true --burst-max 4
# restart batchers
kubectl -n hosted-eu-1 rollout restart deploy/continuous-batcher
```

morgan: executed steps 1-3. Observed continuous_backlog drop from 128 -> 8 in ~75s; queue_depth went from 704 -> 180. Gateway 504s for the tenant fell to near-zero. CLARIPAY confirmed initial improvement and agreed to pause bulk job for 30m. p99 dropped from ~36s to ~1.3s.

support_lee: customer notes: their internal retry logic was exacerbating the spike; theyre adding jitter and a backoff.

alex_engr: follow-ups action list (for postmortem & longer-term fixes):
- investigate why burst_allowed default is false for hosted pools; consider auto-unblock when sustained queue_depth > 600 for >60s
- implement per-tenant kvcache eviction thresholds or async population to avoid head-of-line locking on cache loads
- create a routing rule to detect long-seq heavy tenants and route their bulk jobs to an isolated longseq pool or smaller model variant
- add an alert that triggers when queue_depth > 600 and continuous_backlog > 50 for >30s (page SRE)
- recommend product change: tenant-level bulk job detection heuristics and a templated best-practice doc for customers running large scheduled jobs

jules_sre: Ill own the runbook updates and the autoscaler ticket. alex_engr can you take kvcache async investigation?

alex_engr: will take kvcache async.

support_lee: closing the customer case after CLARIPAY confirms stability at 2026-03-14T12:12Z. Adding traces, commands, and a short summary to the support ticket.

deploy-bot: incident resolved by jules_sre at 2026-03-14T12:12:30Z
